name: sport-coach-mesh-analysis
description: Local program that compares athletic technique using 3D pose estimation.
author: Srivats Iyer

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/clean-electron.mjs && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/postbuild-electron.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.test:database: npm run build:electron && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/testDatabase.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p renderer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p renderer/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
